Internal helper: the data frame's name a result or a chart keeps, where an offered line can be built on it

Source: R/plot.R
dot-jst_kept_data_name.Rd

A result keeps the data frame as its call gave it (data_name: every analysis result since Session 416, jlm()'s since Session 403), which may be an expression – d[d$Age > 30, ]. A line that changes the frame (jrelabel(..., modify = TRUE)) runs only on a plain name; one that reads it runs on a place such as lst$d too. Anything else, and a result that keeps no name, gives NULL, and the line names the placeholder MyData.

Usage

.jst_kept_data_name(dn, place = FALSE)

Arguments

dn

The name as kept, or NULL.

place

Logical(1); whether a place will do.

Value

Character(1) or NULL.
